# Image Generation Rules

## 2. Princípios obrigatórios

- No readable text inside generated images.
- No invented logos, ratings, contact data, claims or watermarks.
- Compose for responsive web use.

## 6. Anatomia obrigatória do prompt

Prompts must state purpose, identity, subject, composition, lighting, texture, layout constraints and output.

## 19. Regras globais de conteúdo

All businesses are fictional demonstrations. Never create fake commercial proof.

## 20. Direção específica — M47 Barber

Use deep black, warm side light, matte-gold restraint and realistic barbershop texture. Keep negative space for HTML copy. Avoid barber poles, skulls and crossed razors.
